text: Ahh, hello there!
zh: 啊，你好！

text:
If you're looking for a trip to the academy, I have to disappoint you.
We're already on our way back to the capital.
zh:
如果你是想去学院的话，那恐怕要让你失望了。
我们已经在返回王都的路上了。

text: How do I get to the capital?
zh: 我要怎么去王都？

text: Is there a way to get a permit?
zh: 有办法拿到通行证吗？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这里做什么？

text: Academy of Mages?
zh: 魔法学院？

text: Where is the Academy?
zh: 学院在哪里？

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: Basically, you only need to follow the road south until you find Roland's farm.
zh: 简单来说，你只需沿着大路一直向南走，直到看见罗兰的农场。

text: From there, keep heading east, and you'll end up in front of the capital.
zh: 从那里继续向东，你就会来到王都门前。

text: But without the official permit, you will not be allowed into the capital.
zh: 不过，没有官方通行证的话，你是不能进入王都的。

text:
Let me think about it.
Usually, everyone had to submit a form, which was processed over a few weeks.
zh:
让我想想。
通常，每个人都得提交一份申请，审批要花上几个星期。

text: But now it is no longer as easy as it once was.
zh: 但如今，事情不像从前那么容易了。

text: If you want to enter to the capital soon, you could ask #:Renbrand:#, one of the highest-ranking royal guards about it.
zh: 如果你想尽快进入王都，可以去问问#:伦布兰德:#，他是皇家卫队里军衔最高的成员之一。

text: You will find him south of the capital, in a camp of the Royal Army.
zh: 你可以在王都以南的皇家军队营地里找到他。

text: As the Royal Guard, it is my duty to help the citizens of the capital.
zh: 身为皇家卫队的一员，帮助王都的市民是我的职责。

text: That's why I make sure that people here can enjoy a safe trip to the Academy of Mages without being attacked by bandits.
zh: 所以我在此确保人们能安全前往魔法学院，不受强盗袭击。

text:
Have you never heard of the Academy?
It is widely known, even outside Grenmark.
zh:
你从没听说过学院吗？
它可是声名远扬，甚至传到了格伦马克之外。

text:
The academy is the place for many young people of the capital when they are looking for an apprenticeship as a magician.
However, only a few are actually accepted as a magician.
zh:
王都的许多年轻人想拜师学习魔法时，都会前往学院。
不过，真正被收为法师的只有寥寥数人。

text: A large part of the people is only interested in the wine that the academy produces, though.
zh: 话说回来，大部分人感兴趣的只是学院酿造的葡萄酒。

text: When you follow the road north of here, and head east as soon as you reach the Stonehenge, you'll find yourself at the gates of the Marin Passage.
zh: 沿着这里北边的大路走，到了巨石阵后立刻转向东，你就会来到马林通道的大门前。

text: However, the gates to the passage are usually closed for people without an explicit permit.
zh: 不过，通道的大门通常不对没有正式通行证的人开放。

text: That's why we, the Royal Guard, have to protect the people who want to visit the academy.
zh: 正因如此，我们皇家卫队才要保护那些想去学院的人。

text: Behind the passage lies the academy.
zh: 穿过通道，就是学院了。

text: Raiders have gathered in the passage, and attack people and merchants.
zh: 掠夺者聚集在通道里，袭击行人和商旅。

text: Of course!
zh: 当然！
